envelope.description: Vendor the LinkML metamodel JSON Schema asset + boot asset-check

body.title: Vendor the LinkML metamodel JSON Schema asset + boot asset-check
body.summary: Add src/assets/artifacts/schemas/linkml-metamodel.schema.json (pinned LinkML metamodel subset for ClassDefinition/SlotDefinition + cardinality) and a boot-time asset validator mirroring docgen/asset-validator.ts that fails loudly if it is missing/unparseable. copy-assets already ships src/assets.
acceptanceChecks: the vendored schema file is present + parseable + records the LinkML version
boot asset-check throws an actionable error when the schema is absent/corrupt
the schema validates a known-good ErDefinition and rejects a malformed one via ajv

tests.name: boot asset-check fails loudly when the vendored metamodel schema is absent
